title: Sunday · the seawall, from the water
venue: Arthur's site (newspaper cadence: six dailies + a Sunday)
logline: Tourist Season from the bay side: the seawall as a wall, the tourists' heads above it, gulls, and in the last tier a dog's head over the wall's edge looking down at the water. The first Sunday drawn from the water.
